trivia.title: Health Trivia
trivia.fact1: Drinking water first thing in the morning helps jumpstart your metabolism.
trivia.fact2: Walking 30 minutes a day reduces the risk of heart disease.
trivia.fact4: Handwashing is one of the best ways to prevent illness.
trivia.fact5: Sleep is as important to health as diet and exercise.
trivia.fact6: Dark chocolate is rich in antioxidants and heart-healthy.
trivia.fact7: Your brain uses more energy than any other organ.
trivia.fact8: Eating fiber-rich foods helps digestion and heart health.
trivia.fact9: Good posture improves breathing and energy levels.
trivia.fact10: Sunlight helps your body produce Vitamin D naturally.

aboutUs.title: Venkataeswara Hospitals
aboutUs.para1: Founded in 2003 by the renowned interventional cardiologist Dr. Thillai Vallal, Venkataeswara Hospitals is a trusted multi-specialty healthcare institution located in the heart of Chennai at Nandanam.
aboutUs.para2: Our 130-bed facility, including advanced ICU care, is equipped with state-of-the-art diagnostic and surgical infrastructure such as MRI, CT, digital X-ray, and fully integrated labs.
aboutUs.para3: Our team of highly experienced doctors, nurses, and staff work in harmony to provide personalized treatment plans across various specialties.
aboutUs.para4: We are particularly proud of our leadership in lifestyle disease management and preventive cardiology.
